sourceText:
Hearty Lentil Soup
By: Anonymous
Published: Friday, December 4, 2009 - 11:47pm

Ingredients




2 cups lentils
8 cups water
3 slices bacon, diced
1 med. onion, chopped
1/2 cup chopped celery
1/4 cup chopped carrots
1 clove garlic, minced
2 1/2 teaspoons salt
1/4 teaspoon pepper
1/w tsp. oregano, crushed
3 tablespoons snipped parsley, if desired

Preparation

1 Rinse lentils. Bring 1 cup lentils and 2 1/2 cups water to boil. Cook covered at simmering until tender, about 35 minutes. When cooked, lentils double in volume. One cup dried lentils will yield about 2 cups cooked lentils. 2 Rinse lentils; drain. Place in large soup kettle with remaining ingredients. Cover and simmer about 2 1/2 to 3 hours. 6-8 servings.
